setting.name: Mistfall Coast
setting.era: Late 19th century — gas lamps, telegrams, bolt-actions; superstition persists
setting.tone: Investigation and dread; polite society over rotten pilings
setting.summary: Mist clings to Harrowport year-round. Every storm washes up something that should have stayed down.

world_rules.magic: Rare — folk charms, drowned-cult rites, relics that cost Sanity. No academies.
world_rules.technology: Late Victorian — rail to Brackenford; electric lights in Harrowport's promenade.
world_rules.death_and_afterlife: Church burial; cultists speak of minds adrift in the fog bank.
world_rules.travel: Steam packet between towns; moor roads unsafe at night.

politics.summary: Harbor Board tariffs, inland landowners blocking reform, smugglers arming both sides, Drowned Lantern cult in the lighthouse service.
politics.law_and_order: Constabulary in towns; fog moor is extralegal.

regions.name: Harrow Bay
regions.description: Salt fog, busy docks, gaslit hills patrolled by paired constables.
regions.travel_notes: Steam packet to Brackenford: 3 hours; fog delays night crossings.

regions.name: Blackwood Hills
regions.description: Peat moors, pine ridges, standing stones and sealed mines.
regions.travel_notes: Coaches by day; Spot Hidden to avoid bog hazards at dusk.

regions.name: Salt Flats
regions.description: Tidal flats at low tide — wreck ribs, quicksand, glassy pools.
regions.travel_notes: Cross with a guide; tide tables mandatory.

cities.name: Harrowport
cities.description: Provincial port of forty thousand souls and one too many secrets.

districts.name: North Docks
districts.description: Tar smell, net menders, customs sheds.

districts.name: Fogward Slums
districts.description: Boarding houses, gin shops, whispered deals.

cities.name: Brackenford
cities.description: Inland market town where landowners slow every reform bill.

locations.name: Harrow Lighthouse
locations.description: Beam cuts fog nightly; keepers rotate weekly.

locations.name: Fogward Chapel of St. Elian
locations.description: Charity kitchen; Father Morse hears confessions.

locations.name: Blackwood Standing Stones
locations.description: Pre-Christian circle; locals avoid at new moon.

locations.name: Sealed Mine Shaft 7
locations.description: Collapsed tin mine; bricked after 1889 deaths.

locations.name: Wreck of the Black Lantern
locations.description: Ribbed hull exposed at low tide; lanterns seen at night.

npcs.name: Inspector Cordelia Vale
npcs.appearance: Sharp grey uniform, scarred knuckles, never unarmed.
npcs.motivations: Close the missing fishers case before the Mayor buries it.
npcs.secrets: Took Mist Runner bribes once; repaid in double.

npcs.name: Father Elias Morse
npcs.personality: Gentle public face, steel in private.

npcs.name: Jonah 'Two-Tide' Marsh
npcs.appearance: Tarred coat, gold earring, fog-grey beard.
npcs.motivations: Keep runners free of Crown hangmen.

npcs.name: Keeper Silas Holt
npcs.appearance: Burned left hand, uniform always pressed.

npcs.name: Lila Bracken
npcs.personality: Gossip hub, loyal to paying guests.

items.name: Brass Fog Lamp
items.mechanics: Navigate fog without penalty for 1 hour.

items.name: Physician's Nerve Tonic
items.mechanics: Recover 1d3 Sanity; CON roll or drowsy.

items.name: Lighthouse Keeper Badge
items.mechanics: Access service ladders; cultists recognize symbol.

items.name: Jade Drowned Idol
items.mechanics: POW roll or lose 1d4 Sanity on first touch.

factions.name: Mist Runners
factions.description: Smuggler confederation using fog and bribed pilots.
factions.goals: Free trade and no Crown tariffs.

factions.name: Drowned Lantern
factions.description: Cult venerating consciousness in the fog sea.
factions.goals: Sink a lighthouse beacon during spring equinox.

lore.title: The Persistent Mist
lore.content: Sailors say the fog thickened after the 1887 Deluge Night when eleven boats vanished in clear weather.

lore.title: Shaft Seven
lore.content: Brackenford sealed Mine Shaft 7 after miners reported singing from flooded tunnels.

lore.title: Black Lantern
lore.content: The wreck appears on flats each decade; keepers who investigate do not return unchanged.

maps.name: Harrowport Chart
maps.description: Docks, Gaslight Promenade, Constabulary Quarter, Fogward Slums.

maps.name: Mistfall Regional
maps.description: Harrow Bay, Blackwood Hills, Salt Flats.

principles: Query the world pack for established locations, NPCs, and encounters before inventing.
Invent only when the pack has no matching content or the party goes off the authored map.
Use encounter tables for random wilderness and urban night scenes.
anti_patterns: Inventing a named shopkeeper when list_location_npcs returns candidates.
Rolling custom random encounters when a biome table exists.

scenarios.situation: Investigators arrive in Harrowport during a week-long fog
Salt Ledger publishes a Harbor Board name
Keeper Holt invites the party to the lighthouse
Low tide exposes the Black Lantern wreck

compatibility.notes: Future engine wiring maps worldpack query tools to adventure module lookups.
